svg.title: One hundred children
svg.desc: Paper-cut scene in front of the big stilt house: a big crowd of exactly one hundred children, all with little black topknots and bright tunics in red, yellow, blue, green, purple, pink, teal and orange, stand in rows from the front to the back, many of them waving. Âu Cơ on the left and Lạc Long Quân on the right smile proudly.
